christians-reading-classics.title: The Declaration of Independence and the Classics with Brad Birzer
christians-reading-classics.description: A single sentence can reorder a civilization, and “we hold these truths to be self-evident” is one of those sentences. Nadya Williams sits down with historian Dr Brad Birzer to read the Declaration of Independence closely and ask why it still sends a jolt through American politics, moral imagination, and public life 250 years later.
